title: Typical Bohnenblust--Hille Ratios
summary: The polynomial Bohnenblust--Hille inequality controls the coefficient $\ell_{2m/(m+1)}$-norm of an $m$-homogeneous polynomial by its supremum norm, with a constant independent of the dimension. We study the associated Bohnenblust--Hille ratio from a probabilistic point of view, by placing normalized surface measure on the Euclidean coefficient sphere. Our results reveal a sharp contrast between the extremal behavior governing the classical Bohnenblust--Hille constants and the typical scale seen in coefficient directions.
